notes:
Summary:
- ClarityRx is a mid-to-large regional health network (multi-hospital system) focused on clinical documentation search for providers and coding auditors. Primary need: high-quality RAG for clinical notes with strict PHI controls.
- Wants dense embeddings + GPU cross-encoder reranker for top-10 precision, but needs cost controls for 100M+ passage index.

Requirements (from discovery):
- Index scale: expect ~80M-150M passages initially (notes, discharge summaries, pathology).
- QPS/latency: interactive provider search target ~200 qps aggregate; p95 end-to-end top-3 results < 250ms in EPIC-like UI flows.
- Cost sensitivity: looking to compare cost-per-query between hosted dense-only vs hybrid sparse+dense + rerank. Target <$0.01/query average for primary search funnel.
- Model preferences: open-model embeddings (instruction-tuned) for retrieval; GPU-accelerated cross-encoder (BERT/DeBERTa family) for reranking; fallback to smaller quantized reranker during peak.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to CPU-quantized model and region-local replica if GPU capacity exhausted.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA BAA mandatory, SSO/SAML, KMS customer-managed keys, comprehensive audit logs (per-token & per-user), retention policy enforcement, and option for on-prem/offline deployment for highest-regulated departments.

Recent timeline & activities:
- 2026-02-20: inbound demo request via website; AE assigned (Jordan Lee).
- 2026-02-24: Prod intro call (Fireflies ff_20260303_clarityrx_intro). High-level need: "search that doctors actually trust" — emphasis on precision and auditability.
- 2026-02-28: Sent security questionnaire + initial sizing worksheet.
- 2026-03-03: Follow-up call with infra + security (SE: Priya Nair present). Clarified on-prem scope and data residency for two hospitals in EU/NA split.
- 2026-03-05: Shared example embedding evaluation notebook and sample index metrics; requested cost models for 3 configurations (hosted optimized, dedicated GPU pool, private on-prem).
- 2026-03-10: Legal flagged need for BAA + additional encryption language; engineering asked for POC dataset ingestion checklist.

POC scope (requested):
- Duration: 6 weeks.
- Goals: Ingest 10M de-identified notes (sample pipeline), benchmark recall@10 and p95 latency for retrieval+rerank, quantify cost-per-query at 50/200/500 qps, validate audit log fidelity and KMS integration.
- Deliverables: perf report, cost model, recommended batching/quantization profile (Redwood Optimize suggestions), and documented rollback/fallback policy for runtimes.

Technical notes / constraints (AE/SE shorthand):
- Want HNSW + IVF hybrid indexing; interested in Redwood offering for autoscaling vector index shards across Dedicated GPUs.
- Concerned about KV cache warming for reranker hot-path; need options for persistent KV cache across pod restarts.
- Will require per-request user-id tagging in logs (for audit) and retention policy per-hospital.
- Data residency: EU hospital data must remain in eu-west region; want private control plane for those tenants.

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- Chief Data Officer: "If retrieval returns noisy results, clinicians won't adopt — precision beats recall in triage workflows."
- Head of Security: "BAA + HSM-backed keys are non-negotiable; show us end-to-end auditability first."

- SE to produce Dedicated sizing + cost table for 3 cluster configs (Priya) — due 2026-03-13.
- Schedule POC kickoff after BAA sign; initial data transfer mechanism review (SCP vs secure transfer appliance).
